results.name: The inline preview uses live block details and its Allow/Deny buttons never create a run
A real waiting block opens the review automatically with labelled dialog, scope, task, tools and cost
Minimize keeps the task waiting; Needs you reopens the same request and focuses the review
A key outside the card never approves; reload preserves the pending request without any decision
Allow once reaches the simulated engine, folds into a receipt, then queues two separate requests
Escape denies only the focused request, stops its children and leaves the other request pending
Enter on the focused dialog allows once; rerunning always asks again
Touch 390px: request stays in the viewport, scrolls, has 44px actions and no keyboard hints
Touch 320px: request stays in the viewport, scrolls, has 44px actions and no keyboard hints
Dark theme and reduced motion use the existing Process tokens
REST failures never show Allowed; double-click sends one action; confirmed retry shows a receipt
WebKit renders the request and submits Deny
